_sources_verifiees: data-lake/GOOGL/10Q/GOOGL_2026-04-30.htm.gz (10-Q T1 2026, pour deriver les flux trimestriels)

controles.affirmation: DOJ Search : jugement final rendu en decembre 2025, il restreint la facon dont Google distribue ses services et l'oblige a partager certaines donnees de recherche avec des concurrents et a leur offrir des services de syndication
controles.verbatim_source: A final judgment was entered in December 2025, which, among other things, imposes restrictions on how Google distributes its services and requires Google to share certain search data with and offer syndication services to certain competitors.

controles.affirmation: L'appel est en cours dans les deux sens : Google ET le DOJ ont fait appel
controles.verbatim_source: In January 2026, we appealed the final judgment and moved to pause implementation of certain remedies. ... In February 2026, the DOJ and state Attorneys General also appealed.

controles.affirmation: ... ce dernier [le DOJ] pouvant demander plus
controles.verbatim_source: Le 10-Q constate seulement que le DOJ et les state Attorneys General ont fait appel en fevrier 2026. Aucun passage ne decrit l'objet ni la portee de leur appel.
controles.correction_proposee: Supprimer la parenthese, ou ecrire : 'le 10-Q ne precise pas ce que le DOJ demande en appel'.

controles.affirmation: Ad tech : decision mixte en avril 2025, ni les outils annonceurs ni les acquisitions DoubleClick et AdMeld juges anticoncurrentiels, mais les outils editeurs juges avoir exclu les rivaux de maniere deloyale
controles.verbatim_source: In April 2025, the US District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia issued a mixed decision in the DOJ case against Google, ruling that neither Google's advertiser tools nor the DoubleClick and AdMeld acquisitions were anticompetitive, but that Google's publisher tools unfairly excluded rivals.

controles.affirmation: Le jugement sur les remedes est attendu, et la ste ecrit elle-meme que la proposition du DOJ contient des remedes structurels pouvant avoir un effet defavorable significatif
controles.verbatim_source: The DOJ's remedy proposal includes structural remedies that could have a material adverse effect on our business. Closing arguments were held in November 2025, and we are awaiting a final judgment.

controles.affirmation: Amende AdSense de 1,5 Md EUR annulee en Europe, annulation frappee d'appel par la Commission, procedure pendante devant la Cour de justice
controles.verbatim_source: In September 2024, the General Court overturned the EC decision and annulled the EUR 1.5 billion fine. The EC has appealed the General Court's decision with the European Court of Justice, which remains pending.

controles.affirmation: Juillet 2026 : la Cour de justice de l'UE a rejete le dernier recours Android, l'amende est definitive et 5,2 Mds $ (amende + interets) payes en cash
controles.verbatim_source: We subsequently appealed the General Court's affirmation of the EC decision, which was denied by the European Court of Justice in July 2026. The EC decision is now final. In July 2026, we made a cash payment of $5.2 billion for the fine plus accrued interest.

controles.affirmation: Amende ad tech de la Commission europeenne de 3,0 Mds EUR, charge de 3,5 Mds $ prise au T3 2025, appel en cours
controles.verbatim_source: The EC decision imposed a EUR 3.0 billion fine and directed Google to cease and desist the alleged 'self-preferencing' practices. We appealed the ruling in November 2025, which remains pending. We recognized a charge of $3.5 billion in the third quarter of 2025.

controles.affirmation: Condamnation privee de 2,1 Mds $ en Suede (PriceRunner/Klarna), provisionnee au T2 2026, appel en cours
controles.verbatim_source: in July 2026, the Stockholm Patent and Market Court issued a decision against Google in a private action brought by PriceRunner (a subsidiary of Klarna) ... The Court awarded the plaintiff approximately $2.1 billion (awarded in multiple currencies) in principal damages plus accrued interest and costs, which we recognized in the second quarter of 2026. We appealed the decision.

controles.affirmation: Constats preliminaires de non-conformite au DMA sur Google Play et Search
controles.verbatim_source: In March 2024, the EC opened two investigations regarding Google's compliance with certain provisions of the European Union's (EU) Digital Markets Act relating to Google Play and Search. In March 2025, the EC issued preliminary findings of non-compliance in both investigations, to which we responded.

controles.affirmation: 17,4 Mds $ d'amendes et reglements provisionnes a court terme au 30 juin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: As of June 30, 2026, we had short-term accrued legal and regulatory fines and settlements of $17.4 billion. This amount primarily included EC fines, in addition to accruals related to other legal matters and regulatory fines and settlements.

controles.affirmation: DMA : partage des donnees de recherche, acces des IA tierces a Android
controles.verbatim_source: The EU's Digital Markets Act, which requires in-scope companies to obtain user consent for combining data across certain products, mandate the sharing of search data with third-party search engines, and require interoperable access to the Android operating system by third-party AI companies (facteurs de risque du 10-Q, pas la section Legal Matters).

controles.affirmation: Google Network (AdSense, Ad Manager, AdMob) recule : -336 M$ de revenus au S1 2026, impressions -12% sur un an au T2 ; 7,3 Mds $ sur 119,8 Mds $ au T2, soit 6% du CA
controles.verbatim_source: Google Network revenues decreased $51 million and $336 million from the three and six months ended June 30, 2025 to the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 ... Impressions change (12)% ; table de revenus : Google Network 7,354 (T2 2025) / 7,303 (T2 2026), Total revenues 119,796. Definition : 'Google Network, which includes revenues generated on Google Network properties participating in AdMob, AdSense, and Google Ad Manager.'
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : l'affirmation adjacente 'c'est precisement l'activite qu'un remede structurel pourrait forcer a ceder' est une inference ; le 10-Q ne precise jamais quel actif serait vise par les remedes structurels.

controles.affirmation: Backstops jusqu'a 51,4 Mds $ (7,6 Mds $ de garanties financieres + 43,8 Mds $ de derives de credit), plus 24,1 Mds $ de backstops supplementaires prevus
controles.verbatim_source: As of June 30, 2026, we provided backstops in the form of financial guarantees and credit derivatives with maximum potential amount of future payments of $7.6 billion and $43.8 billion, respectively. ... We have also entered into an agreement to provide an estimated $24.1 billion of future backstops to support the build-out of data center and energy supply infrastructure.

controles.affirmation: 811,0 Mds $ d'engagements d'achats contractuels dont 200,7 Mds $ a moins d'un an, plus 85,2 Mds $ de loyers de datacenters non demarres ; le 10-Q admet le scenario de capacite excedentaire difficile a redeployer
controles.verbatim_source: we had material purchase commitments and other contractual obligations totaling $811.0 billion, of which $200.7 billion was short-term. These purchase commitments primarily relate to costs for technical infrastructure and inventory ... future lease payments of $85.2 billion ... we may incur additional liabilities, have excess capacity that we cannot easily redeploy
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance de vocabulaire : le 10-Q dit 'technical infrastructure and inventory', pas 'puces'. Ecrire 'infrastructure technique et stocks' serait plus fidele.

controles.affirmation: Chiffre spectaculaire 1 : free cash flow T2 2026 negatif a -5,9 Mds $ (39,1 Mds $ de flux operationnel moins 44,9 Mds $ de capex), premier FCF negatif sur les 22 trimestres depuis 2021 ; T2 2024 +13,5 Mds $, T2 2025 +5,3 Mds $ ; capex trimestriel x8 depuis 2021 (5,5 Mds $ au T2 2021)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : 'Capital expenditures ... were $44.9 billion for the three months ended June 30, 2026' ; flux operationnel S1 2026 84,859 M$ moins T1 2026 45,790 M$ = 39,069 M$ ; 39,069 - 44,924 = -5,855 M$. Historique kpis-haut : 22 trimestres Q1-2021 a Q2-2026, seul Q2-2026 negatif ; Q2-2024 +13,5 ; Q2-2025 +5,3 ; capex Q2-2021 5,5.

controles.affirmation: Chiffre spectaculaire 2 : dette long terme 98,2 Mds $ au 30 juin 2026 contre 10,9 Mds $ au T1 2025 (x9 en 5 trimestres, +316% sur un an) ; charge d'interets 1 278 M$ au T2 2026 contre 261 M$ au T2 2025 ; dividende obligatoire 6,25% sur 19 Mds $ de preferentielles
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 bilan : Long-term debt 98,165 ; 10-Q T1 2025 : Long-term debt 10,886 ; 10-Q T2 2025 : 23,607 (98,165/23,607 = +316%) ; OI&E : Interest expense (261) T2 2025 vs (1,278) T2 2026 ; '19 million shares of 6.25% mandatory convertible preferred stock ... Aggregate net proceeds were $19.0 billion'.

controles.affirmation: Chiffre spectaculaire 3 : 0 $ de rachats aux T1 et T2 2026, 69,5 Mds $ d'autorisation restants ; 11 a 16 Mds $ par trimestre de 2021 a debut 2025, environ 60 Mds $ par an ; 58 M d'actions A et C emises en juin 2026 plus un placement prive de 10 Mds $ aupres de Berkshire Hathaway
controles.verbatim_source: In the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, there were no repurchases of the company's Class A or Class C shares. ... As of June 30, 2026, $69.5 billion remained available ... 29 million Class A shares ... and 29 million Class C shares ... the company completed a $10.0 billion private placement of 14 million Class A and 14 million Class C shares to an affiliate of Berkshire Hathaway Inc. Historique kpis-haut buybacks : 11,4 a 16,2 Mds $ par trimestre de Q1-2021 a Q1-2025.
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : 'environ 60 Mds $ par an' vaut pour 2022-2024 (59 a 62 Mds $) ; 2021 = 50,3 Mds $ et 2025 = 45,7 Mds $ (deja en decrue avant le passage a zero). Le titre 'de 60 Mds $ par an a zero' compresse une baisse etalee sur 2025.

controles.affirmation: Resultat net T2 2026 de 112,1 Mds $ (+298%) incluant 99,0 Mds $ de gains nets sur titres de participation, principalement non realises (SpaceX et une societe privee) ; resultat operationnel 40,8 Mds $ ; BPA 9,11 $ (+294%) ; taux effectif d'impot 19,1%
controles.verbatim_source: OI&E of $98.0 billion for the three months ended June 30, 2026 included net gains on equity securities of $99.0 billion, primarily related to unrealized gains in our equity securities portfolio from SpaceX and a private company. ; Net income available to common stockholders 112,107 (+298%) ; Income from operations 40,770 ; Diluted net income per common share $9.11 (+294%) ; Effective tax rate 19.1%.

controles.affirmation: Levee de 49,6 Mds $ nets en juin 2026, programme ATM de 40 Mds $ non utilise au 30 juin 2026 destine en priorite aux impots sur actions salariales, 20,3 Mds $ d'obligations emises au T2, capex S1 80,6 Mds $ contre 39,6 Mds $ un an avant, guidance 2026 environ 185 Mds $
controles.verbatim_source: In June 2026, we issued a combination of Class A stock and Class C stock and mandatory convertible preferred stock for aggregate net proceeds of $49.6 billion ... The proceeds of the ATM Program are primarily intended to be used to meet tax obligations associated with employee equity grants. As of June 30, 2026, we have not sold any shares under the ATM Program. ; In the second quarter of 2026, we issued senior unsecured notes for net proceeds of $20.3 billion ; During the six months ended June 30, 2025 and 2026, we spent $39.6 billion and $80.6 billion on capital expenditures. Guidance : verbatim call T1 2026 'We are updating our full year 2026 CapEx guidance range to $180 billion to $190 billion' (milieu de fourchette 185).
